# `edit.loop_cut`: Loop cut

Cuts new edge loops across the ring of quads that runs through the selected edges.

- Category: edit
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(ring length x cuts) plus O(c log c) for the corners touched, plus the selector
- Flags: undoable, creates_groups
- Also known as: loop cut, ctrl r, insert edge loop, loop cut and slide, polySplitRing, swift loop

From each selected edge the ring of quads across it is followed in both directions until it closes, reaches the boundary or meets a face that is not a quad (that face gains the cut points as corners). Every ring edge is split evenly `cuts` times and every ring quad becomes `cuts + 1` quads; `offset` slides a single cut toward one side. New edges are `<label>.edges`, the split quads `<label>.faces` (they keep their groups); sharp edges and seams stay on every piece.

**Use for** support loops next to hard edges before subdivision, extra rows for bending (`deform.bend`), and splitting a face to extrude only part of it. Select one edge across the ring, for example a vertical side edge of a cylinder to cut around it.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cuts` | `number` | `1` | Parallel loops per ring (1 to 64). |
| `offset` | `number` | `0.0` | Slides a single cut toward either side, from -1 to 1 (0 is the middle). |
| `select` | `Selector` | required | Edges that the cut crosses: each picks the ring of quads running across it (several edges of one ring cut it once). |
| `target` | `string` | required | Mesh object (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"select":{"edges":{"in_box":{"max":[0.055,0.8,0.01],"min":[0.045,0.2,-0.01]}}},"target":"post"}
```

Result: `post (o:3): cut 1 ring with 1 loop: +8 faces; groups loop_cut_1.edges (8), loop_cut_1.faces (16)`
